unit:
[Unit]
Description=Lucy's always-on teaching agent
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/home/rodbot.guest/course/sovereign-agent-book
ExecStart=/home/rodbot.guest/lucy-venv/bin/python -I /home/rodbot.guest/course/sovereign-agent-book/book/textbook/learner/profrod_sovereign_agent_ch10_wakeups_learner.py serve --root /home/rodbot.guest/lucy-agent
EnvironmentFile=/home/rodbot.guest/lucy-agent/agent.env
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=10
TimeoutStopSec=90
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
